test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes aims to skill rural youth who are poor and provide them with jobs having regular monthly wages or above the minimum wages?

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)** was launched on **25th September 2014**, under the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India.
 
• It aims to **skill rural youth aged 15–35 years**, especially those from **economically disadvantaged households**, and provide them with sustainable employment opportunities.
 
• DDU-GKY focuses on **income generation through regular jobs** where wages are above the **minimum wage** threshold.
 
• The scheme targets rural youth from families below the poverty line identified under the **Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC)** data.
 
• It is part of the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)**, aimed at reducing poverty by promoting diversified and gainful employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Garib Kalyan Rozgar Yojana (GKRY):**

 
 
• Launched in **June 2020** during the COVID-19 pandemic to provide immediate livelihood opportunities for migrant workers.
 
• Focused on **public infrastructure creation** and rural development by employing returnee migrants.
 
• This scheme aimed to generate **125 days of employment** for migrant workers in **116 districts** across six states.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP):**
 
 
• Implemented by the **Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME)** since **2008**.
 
• The scheme focuses on generating employment through **entrepreneurship** and promoting **self-employment ventures** in rural and urban areas.
 
• It provides **financial assistance** for setting up micro-enterprises.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY):**
 
 
• Launched in **2015** under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE).
 
• Aims to provide **short-term skill training** to youth to make them employable.
 
• Focuses on skill certification and training across various sectors based on industry demands.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of DDU-GKY:**
 
 
• Provides **free skill training** in various sectors like IT, hospitality, healthcare, retail, and construction.
 
• Offers placement-linked training programs ensuring job opportunities for candidates post-training.
 
• Special focus on marginalized groups such as **women, differently-abled, and SC/ST communities**.
 
• Supported by **public-private partnerships** to ensure industry-relevant training.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility Criteria for DDU-GKY:**

 
 
• Beneficiaries must belong to rural households listed in **SECC 2011**.
 
• Applicants should be aged between **15–35 years**.
 
• Relaxation in age for categories such as **SC/ST, women, and persons with disabilities** is provided.
 
 
 
• **Funding Support:**
 
 
• DDU-GKY is **100% centrally funded**, with funds allocated based on states' rural population and poverty levels.
 
• Training costs, job placement expenses, and accommodation for candidates are covered under the scheme.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• DDU-GKY has successfully skilled and placed thousands of rural youths in diverse industries.
 
• Promotes **economic growth** by reducing poverty and unemployment in rural areas.
